You should mix up your movement and focus on accuracy.

- 240hz+ display

- wireless mouse with 1ms delay

Special click-timing scenario designed to increase precision for static dots.  The targets vibrate slightly, so that a 'near miss' in a normal static dot scenario is more likely to actually miss.  However, the center of the target does not move enough to affected by the bot vibrating.  A new scoring system has also been introduced- kills reward 0.125 seconds to the challenge timer, each kill adds 1 to the final score, and misses subtract 0.25 from the final score.  The gun used has 4 bullets, and refunds 1 bullet on a hit.  Reloads take 3 seconds (so four misses = reload AND -1 kill to final score).  There is no accuracy penalty.

Cycle Strafe scenarios are scored by remaining time after killing 6 bots (long strafe, long strafe, mid strafe, mid strafe, fast strafe, fast strafe).  Every 1s of using MBS correctly applies 0.5s worth of time score back.  The last word in the scenario title refers to the player's intended dodging patterns to maximize MBS score.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND: Settings->Sounds->"MBS Change Now" to a sound you can hear over your hit sounds.

In this scenario, MBS scoring is used - by default you should see a bar that fills up as you move. As long as you change direction while the bar is green, you get maximum movement score. The bar is almost always green. If you keep moving while the bar is full, you don't get any score. The score is capped to a value that is easy to reach as long as you move throughout the scenario. You should find ways to move in ways that makes aiming easy.

You should find ways to move in ways that makes aiming easy.
